title: Optimal Guidance with Terminal Intercept-Angle Constraints and Acceleration Bounds
summary: Terminal intercept-angle control against a maneuvering target can substantially increase the required missile acceleration, potentially leading to saturation and interception failure unless acceleration limits are explicitly addressed. The engagement is therefore formulated as a linear-quadratic optimal-control problem with bounded acceleration commands. Polynomial approximations of the line-of-sight projection coefficients are used to better represent the nonlinear engagement geometry and estimate the time-to-go.
